sources.snippet: This blog post was created with the help of AI tools. Yes, I used a bit of magic from language models to organize my thoughts and automate the boring parts, but the geeky fun and the in C# are 100% mine. Hi What if you could build a real-time voice conversation app in .NET — speech-to-text, text-to-speech, voice activity detection, and LLM responses — all running locally on your machine ...
